scripts.dev: npm run build -w @query-assistant/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev -w @query-assistant/backend" "npm run dev -w @query-assistant/frontend"
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up -d --wait db
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @query-assistant/contracts && npm run db:generate -w @query-assistant/backend && node scripts/integration.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build -w @query-assistant/contracts && npm run build -w @query-assistant/backend && npm run build -w @query-assistant/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @query-assistant/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @query-assistant/contracts && npm run test -w @query-assistant/contracts && npm run test -w @query-assistant/backend && npm run test -w @query-assistant/frontend && npm run test:setup
scripts.check: npm run docs:check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.docker:admin: docker compose run --rm --no-deps api node backend/dist/auth/provision-admin.js
